question: What if I pick up a 5 hour shift on Nov 7?
text:
ANSWER: The extra shift adds $71.69 to your Wed, Nov 18 paycheck [C14].
WHY:
- Your money runs out on Mon, Nov 9 [C7].
- A shift by Sat, Oct 31 pays Tue, Nov 3 [C15].
DO THIS:
1. Work a shift by Sat, Oct 31 [C15].
NOTE: The extra pay does not change the day you run out [C7].
